parsed.summary: The PR introduces a new parameter `dtypes` to preserve dtypes in DataFrame output, but it may not handle all edge cases and could introduce behavioral regressions.

issues.description: The PR does not handle cases where the input DataFrame has different dtypes than the original input, which could lead to unexpected behavior.
The PR may break existing behavior for transformers that do not support dtype preservation, as it introduces a new parameter that could affect their output.
The code could be more readable if the changes were split into smaller functions or if comments were added to explain the new logic.
